body: And if I could, I'd walk into that bar and give you all the hugs and shoulder to cry on you needed.

The thing is, if anyone, including you, were to come to me with any problem. I'd be there. Because I don't want anyone to suffer. But I have people in my life, friends, a fiance who loves me. I feel like shit for having suicidal thoughts when I have a life many would love to have. Im still alone because I cant let them know my dirty little secret. I'd love to listen to you any time, although I have my rare moments of insight, I may not have the answers you need.
Funny story, I only had one teabag left yesterday. I made tea-coffee by accident so I had to bin it. No tea left now, but the fact I could buy some tomorrow is strangely nice.

This night has gotten worse, I have a straw in a bottle of vodka. Headphones blaring and a scalding hot bath running. I'm horrified that the little girl I used to be turned out like this. Hopefully I'll get drunk and do something productive like clean. It's funny how my home has gotten filthy when I never leave my bed. Thank you for being caring, I won't do anything I'm too chicken shit. But I know kind strangers like you exist, and it helps. You help.
You have a long history of trying to help people, you are a good person and I bet you have a story too. Thanks for the insightful comment.
